title: From Claims to Evidence: A Unified Framework and Critical Analysis of CNN vs. Transformer vs. Mamba in Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: nnUZoo: one nnU-Net harness into which CNN, Transformer and Mamba networks are plugged, so only the network changes between rows; Wilcoxon tests.
adaptation: Use as the code template for the EL benchmark harness: one data folder, one augmentation (label-safe), one schedule, our folds and metrics; swap only networks (nnU-Net, ResEnc-L, MedNeXt, U-Mamba, Swin-UMamba, TransUNet, house U-Net++).
min_experiment: Harness check: reproduce house U-Net++ R34 inside the harness within 0.01 CV crack relF1@2 of the house trainer before adding other networks.
evidence: R: six datasets (microscopy, ultrasound, CT, MRI, PET); CNNs (nnU-Net, U2Net) fast and accurate; SS2D2Net ties nnU-Net with fewer params but longer training; Transformers costly.
